facts.claim: Unit 200 splits a C3/C4 mix: propane overhead, butane bottoms. Design feed 120 m3/h, column has 55 trays.
FIC-101 was deliberately detuned at commissioning because upstream feed composition swings caused oscillation in the first week.
P-102A mechanical seal failed from dry running. LV-202 failed open during an instrument air pressure dip and drained V-102.
MOC-2019-021 (Rev 1) added low-low level trip LSLL-202 on both reflux pumps, check valves CV-102A/B, and low-flow alarm FAL-201.
MOC-2020-014 (Rev 2) upsized FV-201 trim from Cv 45 to Cv 75 for higher feed rates. Side effect: the valve hunts below about 40% load, so operators run FIC-201 in manual below 40%.
PSV-201 set pressure was lowered from 17.2 to 16.5 barg after inspection re-evaluated column MAWP. The Drive datasheet still says 17.2.
MOC-2022-007 (Rev 3) added bypass BV-101 around E-101 to hold feed temperature as E-101 fouled. Cleaning interval is 18 months, last cleaned 2024-03.
MOC-2023-009: TT-203 moved from tray 28 to tray 32 because the tray 28 reading was insensitive. TIC-203 setpoint changed from 78 to 81 C and the loop was retuned (Rev 4).
Near-miss: V-102 overfilled during startup with LIC-202 left in manual.
MOC-2024-031 (Rev 5) changed LV-202 fail position from fail-open to fail-closed, accepting overfill risk covered by the high-level alarm.
During PM, Priya found the LV-202 actuator still configured fail-open and raised WO-88213. Closure was never recorded.
Opening the E-101 bypass makes bottoms run hotter to storage. Off-page storage alarm TAH-301 trips at 55 C, so operators only partially open BV-101. Spans PID-100 and PID-300.
Dana's rule: never start a P-102 pump unless V-102 level is at least 30%.
P-102A seal was replaced again in June 2021 (WO-71120). Suspected cause was misalignment rather than dry running, so P-102B is the preferred duty pump.

contradictions.summary: Set pressure is 17.2 barg in the datasheet and drawing but 16.5 barg per Hannah (Slack, 2021). Correct current value: 16.5 barg, but only supported by Slack.
Fail position is FC per Rev 5 drawing and MOC-2024-031, but Priya found FO in the field in 2025 and the work order was never closed. True current state is unknown.

gaps.summary: No maintenance history or incidents for P-101B.
No MOC or approval document for the PSV-201 re-rating.
No explanation anywhere for why the LV-202 bypass line is 2 inch.
E-103 steam trap sizing basis is undocumented.
Pump vendors, heat duties, and most design pressures are never stated.
